nodes.label: HMAC Author Token (Author Anonymisation)
nodes.rationale: Judges see source diversity without learning real agent identity. Chat_messages.author is HMAC-SHA256(secret, name:surname). Enforced at schema level with no FK from Chat_messages to Agents.

nodes.label: Judge Evaluation Phase 1 — Independent
nodes.rationale: All 20 judges work independently to prevent cross-contamination before Phase 2 structured deliberation.

nodes.label: Judge Evaluation Phase 2 — Deliberation
nodes.rationale: High-variance cases undergo structured deliberation 3-5 rounds, judges revise with confidence tracking. Variance reduction is the key metric.

nodes.label: Persona Drift Mitigation
nodes.rationale: Four layered defences: prompt anchor, explicit style block, selective context window, periodic re-grounding every 20 turns. After 30-40 turns agents converge toward generic LLM voice without mitigation.

nodes.label: Structured Persona Profile (JSON)
nodes.rationale: 800-1500 token JSON profile extracted offline from raw source material. Always in system prompt. Prompt-cached for 60-80% cost savings. Personal detail features are the single most critical fidelity driver per Zhou et al. 2025.

nodes.label: Perturbation Mechanism (Group Chat)
nodes.rationale: Every N turns (10-15), injects character-specific perturbation signal to prevent group dynamic convergence documented by Park et al. 2023 as excessive agreeableness.

nodes.label: External Omniscient Agent
nodes.rationale: Has full context (persona profiles + chat + all judge outputs), evaluates judge quality without influencing evaluation scores.

nodes.label: Jinja2 Prompt Templates
nodes.rationale: Prompts live in .j2 templates not Python strings — independently versionable and diffable. render_prompt() returns (system, user) tuple.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Persona Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 calls gpt-4o-mini with transcript for behavioral fields. Phase 2 calls gpt-4o with no transcript for favored_words/structural_patterns/do_not_say from pure model knowledge. $0.57 for 80 personas.

nodes.label: Hungarian Algorithm for Bijective Persona Assignment
nodes.rationale: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment enforces one-author-per-persona constraint, eliminating greedy argmax duplicate assignments that inflated accuracy metrics.
nodes.norm_label: hungarian algorithm for bijective persona assignment

nodes.label: deviation() Fail-Loudly Convention
nodes.rationale: STRICT_MODE=1 turns deviation() into hard raise for CI. Normal mode logs warning. Prevents silent failures that are harder to debug than crashes.

nodes.label: DB Entity Schema Contract
nodes.rationale: Every named entity has id, name, slug, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, details (JSON). Slug UNIQUE WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. Timestamps UTC ISO-8601, server-set only.

nodes.label: Burst Mode (respond_burst)
nodes.rationale: Multiple message fragments per LLM call via regex [N] parsing. One LLM call, multiple DB writes. Preserves computational economy while simulating human typing with random delays.

nodes.label: Prompt Caching (cache_control ephemeral)
nodes.rationale: Structured profile cached with ephemeral cache_control (5-min TTL). Saves 60-80% of input token cost after first turn.

nodes.label: MCP Tier 2 Write Tools (preview/confirm)
nodes.rationale: All write tools require preview then explicit user confirmation before execution. Prevents unsanctioned writes.

nodes.label: Candidate Set Size Design Choice
nodes.rationale: Three options: K=8 closed set (12.5% baseline, low ecological validity), K=16 expanded (6.25% baseline, recommended), K=N full DB (prohibitive). Recommendation: K=16 with parallel pools and hard guess.

nodes.label: Parallel Judge Pools Design
nodes.rationale: Pool 1 (20 judges) blind identification only. Pool 2 (N judges) fidelity scoring with persona descriptions. Eliminates anchoring bias from sequential design where revealing correct answer before fidelity scoring contaminates scores.
